title: Programiz: Check Armstrong Number
description: Given an integer `n`, return `True` if it is an Armstrong number (sum of digits each raised to power of digit count equals n), else `False`.
constraints:
1 <= n <= 10^9
• Time: O(log N) | Space: O(1)
solution:
def is_armstrong(n: int) -> bool:
    s = str(n)
    power = len(s)
    return sum(int(ch) ** power for ch in s) == n
explanation: Calculates digit power sum and compares with n in O(log N) time.
